newsitem.title: USA: Amer Diversified cancels 2 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Amer Diversified cancels 2 mln shares.

text.p: American Diversified Group Inc said Monday that two million shares issued to United Biomedical Corp as part of a planned merger have been returned to the company for cancelation.

The company said American Diversified has been assigned and retains ownership of United Biomedical's principal assets, including contingent receivables and rights to market Human Serum Albumin and diagnostic test kits in Central and South America.
United Biomedical's receivables for those projects total about $900,000, American Diversified said.
Calls to an American Diversified spokesman were not immediately returned.
